props.headline: Guidelines
props.body:
This is a place for curious people to share and discuss good links. Keep it worth reading:

  • Stay on topic: share what a thoughtful reader would find interesting.
  • Be kind and substantive in replies; argue with ideas, not people.
  • No self-promotion spam: share your own work sparingly and join the discussion.
  • Use the original title of a link; do not editorialise it.
  • If you see abuse, flag it instead of replying to it.
  • One account per person.

props.headline: Frequently asked questions
props.body:
How are stories ranked?

By points and age: a story with more points ranks higher, and every story sinks as it gets older.

What is karma?

The points your stories and comments have earned. It is shown on your profile.

Why can I not flag yet?

Flagging needs some karma, and the site sets how much. Earn karma with good stories and comments.

What does [dead] mean?

A story or comment that was flagged by members or removed by a moderator. Turn on showdead in your profile to see dead items; you can vouch for a dead item if you have enough karma.

What is noprocrast?

A profile setting that locks you out of the site for a while after a visit of the length you choose, to help you stay away.

What are favorites and hide?

Favorite a story or comment to keep it on your favorites list. Hide a story to remove it from your lists.

How does my account work?

An account is a username and a password. An email address is optional, is never shown to anyone, and nothing is sent to it. Use log out everywhere on your profile to sign every browser out.

Can I read the site as data?

Yes, see the API page.

props.headline: API
props.body:
A read-only JSON API and RSS feeds. They show only what a signed-out visitor sees.

  • /p/hn/api/feed/{name}?p=N: a page of a feed. Answer: {"items":[...],"page":N,"has_more":bool}
  • /p/hn/api/item/{number}: one item. Answer: {"id","type","title","url","text","by","points","comments","created_at"}
  • /p/hn/api/user/{name}: one member. Answer: {"name","created_at","karma","about"}
  • /p/hn/rss?feed=news|newest|ask|show|jobs|best: RSS 2.0, 30 items.

An unknown feed, item or user answers 404 {"error":"not found"}.
